# CANDIDATE: J_LOSS_AVOIDANCE_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The losing trades on J days 5/05, 5/06, and 5/07 (call side) occur under specific market conditions that are distinguishable from the winner day conditions. A quality gate that filters out trades under these conditions will avoid the losses without impacting the winner trades.

## Mechanism

We propose to add a new quality gate parameter `j_loss_avoidance_enabled` that, when true, will skip an entry if a specific condition is met. The condition will be determined by analyzing the J loser days and winner days for distinguishing features (e.g., VIX level, trend strength, time of day, etc.). The gate will be placed in the entry path after the existing quality locks. We will conduct a Stage-1 backtest to optimize the condition and measure the impact on edge_capture and Sharpe.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Using J days (n=6) for initial hypothesis risks overfit; Stage-1 backtest will use full 16-month dataset with walk-forward OOS to mitigate
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending Stage-1 completion)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation pending Stage-1 completion)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Filter may incorrectly block winner trades (e.g., 5/04) reducing edge_capture
   - Max drawdown: Potential whipsaw during regime changes causing consecutive losses
   - Blow-up scenario: Overly restrictive filter blocks all trades, yielding zero P&L and missed winners
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive P&L

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Gym validators: 97/98 PASS (core engine integrity)
- Walk-forward OOS: WF ratio ≥ 0.70 on 16-month dataset
- Real-fills: Diff < ±20% vs BS-sim on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04)
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture ≥ 780 (current baseline) on J winners
- Loss avoidance: engine_loss_on_J_losers reduced by ≥ 50% vs baseline
